name: AkuAuction refund-counter mismatch permanently locks project funds
summary: claimProjectFunds() required refundProgress to reach totalBids, but processRefunds() advanced refundProgress once per bidder entry while totalBids counted auction units. After the refund sweep processed all 3,668 bidder entries, refundProgress equalled bidIndex at 3,669 while totalBids remained 5,495, making the project withdrawal condition permanently unsatisfiable and locking the residual auction balance.
notes: This transaction directly deployed the immutable AkuAuction runtime containing processRefunds() and the unreachable claimProjectFunds() condition.

The selected final refund batch exhausted every bidder entry and left exactly 11,539.5 ETH in AkuAuction (5,495 auction units at the 2.1 ETH closing Dutch price), equal to its balance at review time to the wei. Bidder refunds that succeeded are not loss, and the temporary refund-griefing episode caused no permanent loss and is context only. The valuation uses the last DefiLlama ETH observation before that transaction.

The seed record used the first successful refund batch. This record uses the final batch that exhausts every bidder entry and establishes the irrecoverable counter mismatch onchain: only after it does emergencyWithdraw() stop being an escape hatch for the remaining balance, so it is the transaction that makes the permanent loss final.
